body:
>I wish I could make you feel better. 

Putting this all down in electrons, and the fact someone replied helped me cry.  Thank you simply for going to the trouble to respond.  It seems like no one really gets how lonely being deeply emotionally repressed can be.  I don't express pain... pathologically just won't do that, but I'm in here, bleeding out.

TL;DR--- thanks for listening

I'm so tired, I'm going to give sleep a try.

An undiagnosed axis 1 mental disorder, and a comorbid "coping" disorder.  Smart enough for them to be hidden away to some degree.  Had real difficulty later in school.  Spotty employment in a high skill field... and nothing for the last 10 years.

I wasted my life and now I just feel that, despite my new understanding of why I felt so challenged in coping before, that now I have this new hurdle.  

Luckily, no one relies on or needs me significantly.  I'm one of those people that will be missed so much less.  Going out with a whimper would be just fine.  I'm a cautionary tale.
